name: boggle-multiplayer
description: Boggle multijoueur en temps réel, règles et variantes de boggle.fr

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @boggle/shared" "npm run dev -w @boggle/server" "npm run dev -w @boggle/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @boggle/shared && npm run build -w @boggle/client && npm run build -w @boggle/server
